name: sampling-brief
title: Sampling brief for qualified review
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM exposure_groups ORDER BY name

sections.title: Planned work
sections.sql: SELECT task,owner,due,state FROM sampling_plans WHERE group_id=$1 ORDER BY due
sections.note: The hygienist sets the sampling method and duration. This is a task brief, not a sampling protocol.

sections.title: Previous observations
sections.sql: SELECT source_id,sampled_on,result_text,units,decision,report_ref FROM v_samples WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM samples WHERE group_id=$1) ORDER BY sampled_on

name: result-review
title: Exposure record review packet
for_each: SELECT id,source_id FROM samples ORDER BY source_id

sections.title: Source record
sections.note: Private internal packet. Verify source evidence and redact personal information before any disclosure.

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: SELECT revision,decision,reviewer,evidence,reviewed_on FROM reviews WHERE sample_id=$1 ORDER BY revision
sections.note: Record checked means the evidence was checked. It is not a declaration that exposure is safe.

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,due,state,closure_evidence FROM actions WHERE sample_id=$1 ORDER BY due

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: SELECT actor,body,created_at FROM notes WHERE sample_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at
